# The CLI refuses every malformed graph before making any request.
private-workdir
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
server start
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run
stderr '^graph requires --file\n$'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f cycle.yaml
stderr '^graph: node "[ab]": dependency cycle\n$'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f missing.yaml
stderr 'missing dependency "ghost"'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f node-field.yaml
stderr 'field after not found'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f task-field.yaml
stderr 'field cmd not found'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f duplicate.yaml
stderr 'mapping key "name" already defined'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f null-input.yaml
stderr 'node 1: input must not be null'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f null-node.yaml
stderr 'node 1 must be a mapping'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f null-task.yaml
stderr 'node 0: task must not be null'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f no-task.yaml
stderr 'node 0 requires a task'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f empty-argv.yaml
stderr 'task argv must not be empty'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f slot.yaml
stderr 'input slot must be "result"'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f not-dependency.yaml
stderr 'input node must be a dependency'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f no-outputs.yaml
stderr 'declares no outputs'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f mount.yaml
stderr 'data mounts: invalid data mount destination'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f two.yaml
stderr 'exactly one YAML document'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f alias.yaml
stderr '^line 3: graph must not use anchors or aliases\n$'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f merge.yaml
stderr '^line 7: graph must not use merge keys\n$'
# Data mounts need --remote-data, on input template nodes too. Each graph
# also has an environment key only the daemon refuses, so if the local check
# is missing the request fails remotely and the exact stderr line fails.
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f consent.yaml
stderr '^data mounts require --remote-data\n$'
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f consent-template.yaml
stderr '^data mounts require --remote-data\n$'
calls all 0

# A rule that only the daemon applies is refused before acceptance: no
# workflow, job or workload exists afterwards.
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow run -f environment.yaml --request-id environment
stderr 'invalid_argument'
calls WorkflowService/SubmitWorkflow 1
calls job-submissions 0
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow list
! stdout '"id"'
skygo --token-file alice.token --json jobs list
! stdout '"id"'
event-count 0
server stop
! stderr .

# The exact predecessor daemon does not advertise the workflow service. The
# CLI submits no workflow and falls back to no job submission.
old-server start
! skygo --endpoint $OLD_ENDPOINT --token coverage-token workflow run -f valid.yaml --request-id old
stderr 'endpoint does not advertise static-workflows-v1|capability discovery'
old-calls ControlService/GetServerInfo 1
old-calls all 1
old-calls WorkflowService/SubmitWorkflow 0
old-calls job-submissions 0
event-count 0
old-server stop
! stderr .

-- valid.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
-- cycle.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [b]
- name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [a]
-- missing.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [ghost]
-- node-field.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  after: [b]
-- task-field.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {cmd: [/nonexistent/workload]}
-- duplicate.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
-- null-input.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
- name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [a]
  input: ~
-- null-node.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
- ~
-- null-task.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: ~
-- no-task.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
-- empty-argv.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: []}
-- slot.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
- name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [a]
  input: {node: a, slot: output}
-- not-dependency.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload], workdir: {id: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, sha256: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, size: 2048}, outputs: [out]}
- name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  input: {node: a, slot: result}
-- no-outputs.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
- name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [a]
  input: {node: a, slot: result}
-- mount.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task:
    argv: [/nonexistent/workload]
    data_mounts:
    - {reference: corpus, destination: /tmp/corpus, read_only: false}
-- two.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
---
nodes: []
-- alias.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload], directory: &n ~}
- name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [a]
  input: *n
-- merge.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
- name: b
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload]}
  depends_on: [a]
  <<: {name: a, input: ~}
-- consent.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task:
    argv: [/nonexistent/workload]
    env: {BAD-KEY: value}
    data_mounts:
    - {reference: corpus, destination: /mnt/skygo/corpus, read_only: true}
-- consent-template.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task: {argv: [/nonexistent/workload], env: {BAD-KEY: value}, workdir: {id: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, sha256: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, size: 2048}, outputs: [out]}
- name: b
  task:
    argv: [/nonexistent/workload]
    data_mounts:
    - {reference: corpus, destination: /mnt/skygo/corpus, read_only: true}
  depends_on: [a]
  input: {node: a, slot: result}
-- environment.yaml --
nodes:
- name: a
  task:
    argv: [/nonexistent/workload]
    env: {BAD-KEY: value}
